lina (Docs): quick check before I merge the Optimize toolkit PR. spotted three tiny issues: a TypeScript snippet still uses a deprecated helper, the guidance for prefetch TTL is missing (users asked about expiring cached prefixes), and the quant profile note doesn't mention that newer q4_1 exists and may behave differently. can eng/ML glance?
omar (DevEx): paste the TS snippet and the YAML cell you plan to ship and I'll run it in samples.
lina (Docs): TS snippet that landed: 
```ts
// deprecated helper in PR
const out = await client.batch.send({items: [prompt], maxTokens: 200})
console.log(out[0].text)
```
YAML quant cell: 
```yaml
quant_profile: q8_0
recommendation: recommended
```
also the Optimize page adds a small prefetch sample but no TTL guidance.
kai (Runtime): batch.send was removed in v2. use `await client.batch.request({inputs: [prompt], max_tokens:200})`. For cache TTL: our cache.prefetch supports an optional `ttl_ms` param (e.g., `client.cache.prefetch(prefixes, {ttl_ms:600000})`) — add a note that very short TTLs may reduce effectiveness and very long TTLs increase memory. Also mention `cache.invalidate(prefix)` for eviction in workloads that rotate prefixes.
anya (ML): on quant: there is a q4_1 experiment in the catalog that preserves generation fidelity better than q4_0 for some instruction-following prompts; suggest we change wording from "recommended" to "cost-efficient; run small evals" and add a tiny eval suggestion: 200 generation prompts for fidelity + 1k embedding pairs for drift.
omar (DevEx): minimal TS replacement i'm testing: 
```ts
// replacement TS (SDK v2)
const resp = await client.batch.request({ inputs: [prompt], max_tokens: 200 })
console.log(resp[0].text)
```
plus a one-liner prefetch with TTL example for the Optimize docs:
```py
# prefetch with ttl (python)
client.cache.prefetch(["session_v5"], ttl_ms=600000)
resp = client.generate(model="redwood/fast-ggml", prompt=prompt)
```

lina (Docs): I'll update the quant cell to softer phrasing, add the TTL and invalidate examples, and fix the notebook link to /resources/quant-eval-notebook. omar, can you open a tiny PR for the TS + py line fixes so CI picks up?
omar (DevEx): opened PR #1103 with the snippet replacements and updated links. left an inline note about adding cache.invalidate example in a follow-up.
ci-bot: PR #1103 docs-lint: warning fixed, tests green :white_check_mark:
lina (Docs): merging after I add the eval-size footnote and a migration checklist item: "replace batch.send -> client.batch.request; add cache.prefetch TTL where appropriate; watch for q4_1 in catalog." thanks all — closing thread. :tada:
